channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Madaxweyne Ramaphosa oo warqadaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay Safiirka cusub ee Soomaaliya, Aadam Isxaaq
item.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Afrika, Cyril Ramaphosa, ayaa maanta Madaxtooyada Pretoria si rasmi ah uga guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga danjirenimo Safiirka cusub ee Soomaaliya u fadhiya Koonfur Afrika, Amb. Aadam Isxaaq.

item.title: Puntland oo ciidamo geysay deegaanka Roox ee Mudug kadib xiisad dhimasho sababtay
item.description: Dowladda Puntland ayaa ciidamo nabadgelyo geysay deegaanka Roox ee gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo maalmo ka hor ay ka dhacday xiisad sababtay dhimashada hal qof, sida ay werisay Puntland Post.

item.title: IAEA oo Iran ugu baaqday inay kormeerayaasha u ogolaato goobaha nukliyeerka ee muhiimka ah
item.description: Hay'adda Tamarta Atomiga ee Caalamka (IAEA) ayaa warbixin cusub ku sheegtay in si degdeg ah loo baahan yahay in dib loo bilaabo kormeerka Iran, maadaama aysan haysan macluumaad ku saabsan uraaniyamka aadka loo kobciyay, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today oo soo xigatay AFP iyo Reuters.

item.title: Weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah ee Ukraine oo Volgograd ku dilay 4 qof
item.description: Afar qof ayaa la dilay, labana waa la dhaawacay, kadib weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo Ukraine ku qaaday aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Volgograd ee koonfurta Ruushka, sida uu sheegay guddoomiyaha gobolka Andrei Bocharov.

item.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway oo go'aamisay in oggolaanshaha saddex goob oo saliid ah uu sharci-darro ahaa
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway ayaa 13-kii November go'aamisay in oggolaanshihii dowladdu siisay saddex goob oo saliid iyo gaas ah oo ku yaal Badda Waqooyi uu ahaa mid aan ansax ahayn, maadaama aan la qiimeyn saameynta cimilada, sida ay werisay Sweden Herald.

item.title: Ciidamada IRGC oo sheegay in markab gaas dareere ah uu ku qarxay miino bariga Marinka Hormuz
item.description: Ciidamada badda ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa Jimcaha sheegay in markab sida gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha (LNG) uu si xoog leh u qarxay kaddib markii uu ku dhacay miino badeed bariga Marinka Hormuz, sheegashadaas oo aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin.

item.title: Zelensky: Ukraine iyo Ruushka waxay ku heshiiyeen isweydaarsigii maxaabiista dagaal ee ugu weynaa
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, ayaa 12-kii November magaalada Dublin ka sheegay in Ukraine iyo Ruushka ay isku raaceen isweydaarsiga maxaabiista dagaal ee ugu weyn ilaa hadda, kaddib kulan uu la yeeshay ergayada Mareykanka Steve Witkoff iyo Jared Kushner, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Kosovo oo Soomaaliya ka codsatay inay ka caawiso helitaanka sagaal xubnood oo wafdi Soomaaliyeed ka maqan
item.description: Dowladda Kosovo ayaa warqad diblomaasiyadeed ku weydiisatay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya inay ka caawiso ogaanshaha halka ay ku sugan yihiin sagaal xubnood oo ka tirsanaa wafdi Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo 27-kii October ka baxay hoygoodii magaalada Prishtina iyaga oo aan cidna ogeysiin, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Jubaland oo diiday magacaabista hoggaanka Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka ee Golaha Wasiirrada
item.description: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha ee Jubaland ayaa sheegtay inaysan aqoonsanayn magacaabista hoggaanka Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka, iyadoo ku doodday in hannaanka dhismaha hay'adda aan lala tashan dowlad-goboleedyada, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Kalonzo Musyoka oo u ambabaxaya Mareykanka si uu ula kulmo xildhibaannada Congress-ka ka hor doorashada 2027
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper ee Kenya, Kalonzo Musyoka, ayaa 18 ilaa 24 November u safraya Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu kula kulmi doono xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka isla markaana la kulmi doono Kenyanka qurbaha, sida ay werisay Capital FM.

item.title: Muqdisho oo markii ugu horreysay martigelisay shirka Guddiga Xoghayeyaasha Joogtada ah ee IGAD iyo CEWARN
item.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horreysay magaalada Muqdisho ku qabatay shir laba maalmood ah oo ay yeesheen Guddiga Xoghayeyaasha Joogtada ah ee IGAD iyo xarunta digniinaha hore ee colaadaha CEWARN, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Senator Chris Van Hollen oo ku dhawaaqay inuu Chuck Schumer kula tartamayo hoggaanka Dimuqraadiga ee Aqalka Sare
item.description: Senator-ka Dimuqraadiga ah ee gobolka Maryland, Chris Van Hollen, ayaa Khamiistii sheegay inuu u tartamayo jagada Hoggaamiyaha Aqlabiyadda ee Aqalka Sare ee Mareykanka, isagoo noqday senator-kii ugu horreeyay ee si toos ah u loolama Chuck Schumer, sida ay werisay Euronews.

item.title: Cade Cunningham oo taariikh NBA sameeyay: 52 dhibcood, 11 caawin iyo 0 kubbad lumis
item.description: Xiddiga Detroit Pistons Cade Cunningham ayaa Khamiistii dhaliyay 52 dhibcood, kana caawiyay 11, isagoo aan lumin hal kubbad, xilli Pistons ay 144-140 kaga adkaadeen Washington Wizards kadib 2 waqti oo dheeri ah, sida ay werisay The Athletic.

item.title: Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran oo sheegtay inay weerar ku qaadeen goob radar oo Mareykan ah oo ku taal Bahrain
item.description: Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran (IRGC) ayaa sheegay inay beegsadeen goob radar digniin hore oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay Bahrain, iyagoo ku tilmaamay aargoosi weerar cirka laga soo qaaday oo ku dhacay munaarad isgaarsiineed oo ku taal koonfurta Iran, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Maxkamad Isbaanya ah oo hakisay hawlaha kooxda midigta fog ee Núcleo Nacional
item.description: Garsoore ku sugan magaalada Gijón ee waqooyiga Isbaanya ayaa Khamiistii hakiyay hawlaha kooxda midigta fog ee Núcleo Nacional, iyadoo la baarayo dambiyo nacayb iyo urur sharci darro ah, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: FBI: Haakarro Kuuriyada Waqooyi ah oo wicitaanno muuqaal been ah ku xaday in ka badan $400 milyan oo crypto ah
item.description: Hay'adda FBI ee Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in haakarro ay dowladda Kuuriyada Waqooyi taageerto ay in ka badan $400 milyan oo lacag crypto ah ku xadeen iyagoo adeegsanaya wicitaanno muuqaal ah oo been abuur ah si ay u xadaan aqoonsiga dadka, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay inuu ka fiirsan doono xoog militari oo ka dhan ah Cuba ka hor inta uusan xilka ka degin
item.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu hubaal ka fiirsan doono adeegsiga xoog militari oo ka dhan ah Cuba, isagoo intaas ku daray inuu doonayo in arrinta Cuba la dhammeeyo ka hor inta uusan xilka ka degin 2029, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Zelensky oo soo dhoweeyay in Yurub lagu daro wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada nabadda Ukraine iyo Ruushka
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa soo dhoweeyay ballanqaad ay bixiyeen ergooyinka Mareykanka Jared Kushner iyo Steve Witkoff oo ah in wakiillo ka socda Midowga Yurub lagu daro wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada nabadda ee Ruushka, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Booliska Haiti oo dib ula wareegay garoonka kubadda cagta ee qaranka oo 2 sano ay haysteen kooxaha burcadda
item.description: Ciidamada amniga Haiti ayaa Khamiistii dib gacanta ugu soo celiyay garoonka ugu weyn ee kubadda cagta ee dalka, kaas oo 2 sano ay gacanta ku hayeen kooxaha burcadda, sida ay werisay France 24.

item.title: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Albania oo sheegay in shirka NATO ee 2027 aan lagu qaban doonin Tirana
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Albania Edi Rama ayaa sheegay in NATO aysan sannadka soo socda shirkeeda ku qaban doonin Albania sidii loo qorsheeyay, xilli dowladdiisu ay wajahayso dhaleeceyn ku saabsan kharashka difaaca iyo mudaaharaadyo gudaha ah, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong iyo Yordan Alvarez oo codad buuxa loogu doortay ciyaartoyda ugu qiimaha badan MLB 2026
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Chicago Cubs Pete Crow-Armstrong iyo ciyaaryahanka Houston Astros Yordan Alvarez ayaa Khamiistii lagu dhawaaqay inay yihiin ciyaartoyda ugu qiimaha badan (MVP) ee National League iyo American League, iyagoo labaduba helay codadka oo dhan, sida ay werisay The Guardian.

item.title: Maxkamad ku taal Kaliningrad oo 12 sano xabsi ku xukuntay qareen u dooda xuquuqda aadanaha
item.description: Maxkamad ku taal gobolka Kaliningrad ee Ruushka ayaa Khamiistii 12 sano oo xabsi ah ku xukuntay Maria Bontsler, qareen 66 jir ah oo difaaci jirtay dadka lagu eedeeyo dambiyo siyaasadeed, kadib markii lagu helay khiyaano qaran, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Mauricio Pochettino oo heshiis 2 sano iyo badh ah ku gaaray inuu tababare u noqdo Manchester United
item.description: Manchester United iyo Mauricio Pochettino, tababaraha xulka Mareykanka, ayaa heshiis ku gaaray inuu noqdo tababaraha cusub ee kooxda, isagoo bedelaya Michael Carrick oo Khamiistii xilka laga qaaday, sida ay werisay Sky Sports.

item.title: Burburka dhismaha Brooklyn: tirada dadka dhintay oo gaartay 8, oo ay ku jiraan 2 carruur ah
item.description: Mas'uuliyiinta magaalada New York ayaa Khamiistii sheegay in 8 qof, oo ay ku jiraan 2 carruur ah, ay ku dhinteen burburkii dhismo 3 dabaq ah oo Arbacadii ku dumay goob dhismo oo ku taal degmada Brooklyn, sida ay werisay France 24.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay inuusan ka waaban doonin inuu xoog ka adeegsado Iran haddii xulafada iyo maraakiibta la khatar geliyo
item.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Khamiistii sheegay inuusan ka waaban doonin inuu ciidan ka adeegsado Iran haddii uu arko in xaaladdu ka soo horjeedo Washington, isagoo intaas ku daray in laga yaabo inuu hadda sidaas sameeyo, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Guddiga doorashada oo xisbiyada siin waayay jadwal cad oo doorashada 22 December
item.description: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ee Koonfur Suudaan (NEC) ayaa Khamiistii magaalada Juba shir kula yeeshay xisbiyada siyaasadda si looga wada hadlo diyaargarowga doorashada guud ee 22 December, balse xisbiyada ayaa sheegay in aan la siin jadwal cad oo lagu dhammaystirayo hawlaha harsan, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.

item.title: Cillad ku timid adeegyada Microsoft oo saameysay Outlook, Teams iyo Copilot
item.description: Kumanaan isticmaalayaal ah oo adeegyada Microsoft ah ayaa Khamiistii la kulmay dhibaatooyin ku saabsan emailka Outlook, Teams, Copilot iyo adeegyo kale oo Microsoft 365 ah, kadib markii server-yo si lama filaan ah u shaqeyn waayeen, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Rwanda oo COP31 ka codsatay maalgelin $3 bilyan oo koronto ah iyo ilaalinta daadadka Kigali
item.description: Dowladda Rwanda ayaa shirka cimilada ee COP31 ka codsatay maalgelin caalami ah oo lagu taageerayo korontada, adkaysiga magaalooyinka iyo beeraha, iyadoo sheegtay inay u baahan tahay ku dhowaad 3.05 bilyan oo doollar qorshaheeda korontada, sida ay werisay KT Press.

item.title: Khubaro oo cambaareeyay xil ka qaadista Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Bashe Yuusuf Axmed
item.description: Koox khubaro ah ayaa maanta cambaareeyay xil ka qaadista sharci-darrada ah ee Dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku sameysay Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Bashe Yuusuf Axmed, iyo dhaarinta qof loogu magacdaray beddelkiisa, iyaga oo ku tilmaamay faragelin cad oo lagu hayo madax-bannaanida garsoorka.

item.title: Harry Kane oo jebiyay rikoorka kulamada ugu badan ee xulka Ingiriiska, isagoo gaaray 126
item.description: Weeraryahanka Bayern Munich Harry Kane ayaa Khamiistii noqday ciyaaryahanka ugu kulamada badan taariikhda xulka ragga Ingiriiska, kadib markii lagu bilaabay ciyaartii Nations League ee Croatia ee garoonka Wembley, taas oo ahayd kulankiisii 126-aad, sida ay werisay bogga rasmiga ah ee Bundesliga.
